name: Nica Schwartz
source:
A cunning, but seemingly frivolous member of Vogel who has the ability to toy with feelings of love.

As a result, he manipulates affection toward him freely, including yours.

He's obsessed with money and power, but are those shallow desires truly what he wants most...?

Organization: Vogel
Fairy Tale Curse: Swan Lake's Black Swan

[Official English in-game introduction]
